t: This is 59 New Cavendish Street in Marylebone, an early twentieth-century former house. It was designed by Sir Frank Minshull Elgood, an English architect based in London who lived from 1865 to 1948. The material I have on the building is limited, so what I can say is that you're looking at a house by a London architect, standing among the streets of Marylebone.
